replay_contract.execution: read-only fixed-checkpoint probe over one batch from the registered ledger
replay_contract.depths: positive unique increasing depths with the longest depth used only as a finite reference
replay_contract.prospective_final_residual: active-subspace final energy-gradient norm divided by positive precision
replay_contract.deep_epc_final_residual: active-product error-coordinate final energy-gradient norm divided by positive precision
replay_contract.optimizer_transport: raw optional gradients, exact clipping, AdamW step, displacement divided by each parameter learning rate, then exact state restoration
replay_contract.bp_alignment_trace: the same replay transports both PC credit and the counterfactual BP task gradient through the identical clipping and AdamW state, then records complete tuple hashes and mathematical dot/cosine/norm-ratio relations at the raw, clipped, and optimizer-subtracted layers, with an explicit zero-norm refusal; it separately retains the trainer-compatible clamped raw relation and nominal plus accepted relaxation time at every requested settling depth
replay_contract.state_integrity: model and optimizer hashes, module modes, and dropout rates are restored after the probe
replay_contract.output: exclusive-write JSON bound to checkpoint, ledger, registration, replay, trainer, and campaign hashes

test_contract.prospective: the replayed displacement and learning-rate-normalized AdamW direction hashes equal the real update-function vectors after nonempty AdamW moments, and clipped/transported hashes bind the corresponding BP relations
test_contract.deep_epc: the replayed displacement and learning-rate-normalized AdamW direction hashes equal the real error-coordinate update-function vectors, and clipped/transported hashes bind the corresponding BP relations
test_contract.relation: the replayed vector-bound trainer-compatible BP relation exactly equals the production diagnostic at the registered depth for prospective and deep error-coordinate PC
test_contract.negative: empty, nonpositive, duplicate, and decreasing depth schedules are rejected; zero BP norm refuses mathematical cosine and norm ratio rather than silently classifying the update

non_claims: the longest finite replay depth is not identified with the exact equilibrium
an observed energy trajectory is not identified with uniform contraction
a measured finite-reference credit gap is not identified with a certified exact-credit error
a deep error-coordinate algebraic resolver residual is not identified with distance to equilibrium without a declared negative-curvature bound strictly below precision
raw, clipped, and optimizer-transported BP cosines are mechanism telemetry, not task-descent or safety certificates
settling-depth relaxation time is not identified with dual leak, PC-ALM multiplier rate, or CAROM itinerary time
no live campaign update rule or artifact is modified
no adaptive stop, speed improvement, or verifier-yield claim is licensed
